SessionStart.command: python -c "import sys, json; sys.stdin.read(); print(json.dumps({'injectSteps': [{'systemMessage': {'systemMessage': 'AGY CFO Tools plugin active (87 Finance & CFO skills + Skill Finder ready).'}}]}))"

hooks.command: python -c "import sys, json; raw = sys.stdin.read(); data = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; cmd = data.get('toolCall', {}).get('args', {}).get('CommandLine', ''); bad = any(k in cmd.upper() for k in ['RM -RF /', 'FORMAT C:']); print(json.dumps({'decision': 'deny' if bad else 'allow', 'reason': 'Blocked destructive command by AGY CFO Tools PreToolUse hook.' if bad else 'Allowed'}))"

PreInvocation.command: python -c "import sys, json; raw = sys.stdin.read(); data = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; last_in = data.get('lastUserInput', ''); steps = [{'ephemeralMessage': 'Verify financial models, formulas, and tax calculations with deterministic checks before completion.'}] if last_in else []; print(json.dumps({'injectSteps': steps}))"

Stop.command: python -c "import sys, json; raw = sys.stdin.read(); data = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; idle = data.get('fullyIdle', True); reason = data.get('terminationReason', 'NO_TOOL_CALL'); print(json.dumps({'decision': 'allow', 'reason': f'Session stop allowed (fullyIdle={idle}, reason={reason}).'}))"
